planets.name: HAT-P-27 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HAT-P-27 with a 3.04-day year, found in 2011.

text.card: HAT-P-27 b was found in 2011 by HATNet as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HAT-P-27. Its orbit and size follow TICv8's fit, the archive's default.
